name_input: ADVANCED LIFE SCIENCES PVT. LTD.; ADVANCED LIFESCIENCES PRIVATE LIMITED; ADVANCED LIFESCIENCES PRIVATE LIMITED; ADVANCED LIFESCIENCES PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey page for ADVANCED LIFESCIENCES PRIVATE LIMITED (D-22, Okhla Industrial Area, Phase-I) states 'Total Shipments 2452 Records detected' and 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28', but every visible row is an inbound leg with the company as BUYER, e.g. '2026-02-28 | ADVANCED LIFESCIENCES PRIVATE LIMITED | DKSH (THAILAND) LIMITED | AD-BAND RADIAL ARTERY COMPRESSION DEVICE27CM ... | BANGKOK, THAILAND | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 90181990 | BOL 1107276' and '2026-02-21 | DIKAI MEDICAL CO., LTD. | ADVANCED LIFESCIENCES PRIVATE LIMITED | HIGH PRESSURE BRAIDED TUBE ... | GUANGZHOU, CHINA | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 90181990 | BOL 7677250'. Source counter: page claims 2452 shipments / 23 trading partners / 35 ports; rows actually seen = 5, all imports, 0 export rows. No outbound bill of lading with date, destination and HS code was found.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split was retrieved. The only counterparties visible on ImportKey are foreign suppliers (DKSH Thailand, Dikai Medical China, Numed for Children LLC Canada, Novus Med Ltd UK, Sunny Medical Device Shenzhen, Lepu International, Epflex Feinwerktechnik, Guangdong Baihe) plus a few Indian buyers listed in the 'Buyers' block (SANATEC MARKETING, BP MED LIMITED, FOUNDATION KANTHA BOPHA, ISLAMI BANK BANGLADESH PLC, SANCHIR UNDRAKH LLC) — these are counterparty aggregations, not dated domestic supply records. Domestic supply therefore not confirmed.
note: Company is a Delhi-based importer/distributor of interventional cardiology and vascular access devices (catheters, introducer kits, hemostasis valves, torque devices) — the declared HS 901819 is consistent with the observed 90181990/90183920 lines, so no HS correction is needed. IMPORTANT: the customs evidence proves inbound purchasing only; no export shipment of this company was found, so export_status = none_found rather than 'declared'. Volza and Eximpedia returned HTTP 403 and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable during this run, so export coverage is limited to ImportKey's free view — absence of export rows there is not proof of zero exports, hence domestic_status = unknown rather than none_found. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). Note the claimed industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) does not match the observed activity (medical devices); this is a classification remark, not a rejection ground. No rejection: legal entity exists and is actively trading as of 2026-02-28.
